plan: Defensively copy inputs and preflight missing references with stable diagnostics.
Build one clearance-filtered intermediate tree that suppresses empty sections and assigns citations in first-use order.
Render that tree through deterministic text, escaped HTML, and stable-key JSON emitters.

trace.source_relation: The editor removes forbidden passages before a photocopy reaches production.
trace.target_mechanism: A shared clearance-filtering pass creates only visible, nonempty sections before format emission.

trace.source_relation: Footnotes are renumbered according to their first appearance on the cleared copy.
trace.target_mechanism: The filtering pass assigns numbers through an insertion-ordered source-ID registry and reuses an existing number for repeated references.

trace.source_relation: Different typesetters work from the same approved copy.
trace.target_mechanism: The text, HTML, and JSON emitters all consume the same filtered section and reference structures.
